hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

experiment.description: Two requests share a long stable prefix (~2498 tokens) and differ only in the final question.

requests.suffix: Question one: what did we decide about component 7?
Question two: what did we decide about component 42?

interpretation: vLLM reused the materialized stable prefix through its native paged-KV prefix cache on the second request (2480 cached prompt tokens). This validates the stable-prefix contract of the materializer against a real inference runtime.
caveats: Small 0.5B model and one synthetic prefix; not a production workload.
This is vLLM-native prefix caching, not an external paged-KV connector with custom block paging.
Single run on one GPU; no statistical claims.
Server credentials and host details are intentionally not stored in the repository.
